title: Social capital and business performance of women-owned MSMEs: the role of entrepreneurial agility and digital strategy
affiliations: , University of Dubai, , , IMI New Delhi and Universiti Utara Malaysia

detail.title: Social capital and business performance of women-owned MSMEs: the role of entrepreneurial agility and digital strategy
detail.abstract: Purpose : This study examines the relationship among social capital (SC), entrepreneurial agility (EA), and digital strategy (DS) in driving business performance (BP) among women-led micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs).Design/methodology/approach: A quantitative approach was employed to test the hypotheses using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). Data were collected from 390 women-owned/managed MSMEs in Malaysia.Findings: SC, particularly structural and relational capital, positively influences BP, with EA serving as a significant mediator. Additionally, DS strengthens the impact of EA on BP.Research limitations/implications: This study is limited to women-led MSMEs in Malaysia, and the findings may not be generalizable to other emerging economies. The study offers novel insights by integrating the resource-based view (RBV) with dynamic capability theory (DCT) and Strategic Fit Theory (SFT) to explain how SC, EA, and DS influence women’s BP.Practical/managerial implications: It provides recommendations for business managers and policymakers to design development programs for women entrepreneurs. It presents evidence of EA with technology, which plays a significant role in transforming SC into innovative outcomes and creating value for MSMEs in emerging markets.Social/economic implications: By improving SC, agility, knowledge sharing, and facilitating technological advancements, women entrepreneurs can contribute to economic growth and development.Originality: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first attempt to examine the moderate mediation relationship among SC, EA, DS, and BP using RBV, DCT, and SFT. This study fills a crucial gap in the literature by providing empirical evidence on MSMEs in emerging economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨社会资本、创业敏捷性和数字战略对女性主导的中小微企业绩效的影响，发现社会资本通过创业敏捷性间接提升绩效，数字战略增强创业敏捷性对绩效的作用。
AI.research_question: 社会资本、创业敏捷性和数字战略如何共同影响女性主导的中小微企业的业务绩效？
AI.motivation: 填补关于女性企业家在数字经济中如何利用社会资本和敏捷性提升绩效的研究空白，特别是在新兴经济体的中小微企业背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合资源基础观、动态能力理论和战略匹配理论，解释社会资本、创业敏捷性和数字战略如何影响企业绩效。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型，收集马来西亚390家女性所有/管理的中小微企业数据。
AI.findings: 社会资本（特别是结构和关系资本）正向影响业务绩效，创业敏捷性在其中起显著中介作用；数字战略增强创业敏捷性对绩效的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次整合资源基础观、动态能力理论和战略匹配理论，检验社会资本、创业敏捷性、数字战略和业务绩效之间的调节中介关系，为新兴经济体中小微企业研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者和政策制定者提供设计女性创业发展项目的建议，展示技术驱动的创业敏捷性在将社会资本转化为创新成果和创造价值中的重要作用。

title: Study on emission law and disaster-causing mechanism of floor oil-type gas in coal-oil-gas symbiotic mines—— A case study of No.2 Coal Mine in Huangling Mining Area
affiliations: , , , , Shandong University of Science and Technology, , ,  and Shandong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Study on emission law and disaster-causing mechanism of floor oil-type gas in coal-oil-gas symbiotic mines—— A case study of No.2 Coal Mine in Huangling Mining Area
detail.abstract: Aiming at the problem of abnormal emission of oil-type gas from the floor faced by No.2 Coal Mine of Huangling Mining Area in the Ordos Basin under the oil-gas-coal symbiotic environment, this study comprehensively applies field measurement and FLAC3D numerical simulation methods, and systematically analyzes the emission law of oil-type gas based on measured data. The results show that: the emissions are mainly concentrated in the floor heave fracture zone in the middle of the roadway, 5 ~ 10 meters ahead of the working face, and distributed in a contiguous area; the emission of oil-type gas from boreholes conforms to the power law and decreases rapidly within one week; when the reservoir is close to the No.2 Coal Seam, during the tunneling process, there is a law that the emission of oil-type gas decreases with the increase of the distance between the reservoir and the No.2 Coal Seam. The study further identifies in-situ stress, geological structures, and oil-type gas pressure as the three main controlling factors for the abnormal emission of oil-type gas from the floor. The numerical simulation results reveal the mechanism of oil-type gas emission from the floor during the mining process: the advancement of the working face causes the periodic distribution of floor stress; during the normal mining stage, the coal-rock mass on the working face floor presents original stress areas, stress concentration areas, pressure relief areas, and stress recovery areas. This leads to continuous periodic damage to the rock strata, and ultimately forms a pressure relief gas conduction zone of approximately 40 meters in front of the working face. This mechanism indicates that when the oil-type gas reservoir is outside this pressure-relief zone, roadway tunneling can remain safe.

AI.tldr: 针对鄂尔多斯盆地黄陵矿区2号煤矿在油气煤共生环境下面临的底板油型气异常涌出问题，本研究综合应用现场实测和FLAC3D数值模拟方法，基于实测数据系统分析了油型气涌出规律。研究发现涌出主要集中在工作面前方5-10米巷道中部底鼓裂隙带，呈连续分布；钻孔油型气涌出符合幂律分布，一周内快速衰减；当储层靠近2号煤层时，掘进过程中油型气涌出量随储层与煤层距离增加而减少。研究进一步确定了地应力、地质构造和油型气压力为油型气异常涌出的三大主控因素。数值模拟揭示了开采过程中底板油型气涌出机理：工作面推进导致底板应力周期性分布，形成原始应力区、应力集中区、卸压区和应力恢复区，最终在工作面前方形成约40米的卸压气体传导带。
AI.research_question: 在油气煤共生环境下，煤矿底板油型气异常涌出的规律、主控因素及其形成机理是什么？
AI.motivation: 鄂尔多斯盆地黄陵矿区2号煤矿面临油气煤共生环境下底板油型气异常涌出的安全问题，这威胁煤矿安全生产，需要系统研究其涌出规律和控制机理，为煤矿安全开采提供科学依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于岩石力学、气体运移理论和矿山压力理论，结合油气煤共生地质环境特征，分析底板油型气涌出的力学机制和气体运移规律。
AI.method: 综合应用现场实测（包括巷道监测、钻孔观测）和FLAC3D数值模拟方法，系统分析油型气涌出规律，结合实测数据验证数值模拟结果。
AI.findings: 1. 油型气涌出主要集中在工作面前方5-10米巷道中部底鼓裂隙带，呈连续分布；2. 钻孔油型气涌出符合幂律分布，一周内快速衰减；3. 储层靠近煤层时，涌出量随距离增加而减少；4. 地应力、地质构造和油型气压力是三大主控因素；5. 工作面推进形成底板应力周期性分布，最终在工作面前方形成约40米的卸压气体传导带。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了油气煤共生环境下底板油型气涌出的力学机制和运移规律；2. 建立了底板油型气涌出的主控因素理论框架；3. 提出了工作面推进过程中底板应力周期性分布和卸压气体传导带形成的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为煤矿底板油型气异常涌出预测和防治提供了科学依据；2. 确定了40米卸压气体传导带的安全距离标准；3. 为类似地质条件下的煤矿安全开采提供了技术指导；4. 有助于制定针对性的瓦斯治理措施和安全生产规程。
